name: admob-mcp
description: Google AdMob (ads): me, list_accounts, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_admob_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_admob_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the AdMob API enabled.

platform_mcp_admob_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_admob_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

platform_mcp_admob_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_admob_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admob.readonly (or admob.report); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/accounts: the AdMob publisher accounts the credentials can access ({account: [{name, publisherId, reportingTimeZone, currencyCode}]}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v1/accounts. `id` is the publisher id (pub-…) used as account_id by get_report; `name` is the resource name accounts/pub-…. Only the first page is returned (pageToken paging).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/networkReport:generate with a reportSpec over DATE and APP and metrics IMPRESSIONS, CLICKS, ESTIMATED_EARNINGS (account_id is the publisher id pub-…). AdMob is a publisher (monetisation) platform: earnings are revenue in micros of the account currency (6381903 = 6.38), dates are YYYYMMDD. The header/footer elements of the streamed array are dropped. `campaign_id` is not applicable.
